data.title: Make an Excel reporting step repeatable with Office Scripts
data.summary: Record a bounded formatting task, test reruns and connect the existing script to a manually tested flow before scheduling it.

facts.text: Office Scripts can run through Excel Online (Business) actions in Power Automate. The documented actions distinguish scripts in OneDrive from scripts in a SharePoint library; business Microsoft 365 licensing is required for this integration.

sources.title: Run Office Scripts with Power Automate

prerequisites: Office Scripts available under your organization policy and an eligible business account for Power Automate integration.
An existing workbook/table, a named owner and a small reporting task with known output.
steps: Search the workbook and existing flows for an equivalent script. Reuse its owner and location if it meets the task.
In Excel's Automate tab, record or edit a script for one bounded action such as formatting the existing report table. Use explicit table names.
Run it manually on a copy and inspect row counts, totals and formatting. Run it a second time to detect duplicate rows, sheets or charts.
Create or extend a manually triggered flow using Excel Online (Business), selecting the correct Run script action for its storage location.
Record workbook/script identifiers and inspect flow output. Test missing-table and locked-file behavior before any schedule.
After owner review, configure the intended cadence and failure handling. Retain an execution receipt for each actual run.
data.output: A reusable script and a reviewed flow definition with rerun and failure evidence.
validation: The second run does not duplicate output objects or change finance control totals.
A failed run is visible and cannot silently replace a previous valid report.
limitations: Recipe not executed in Excel/Power Automate by Sintra; no schedule has been enabled.
A defined schedule is not proof of delivery. Connector permissions and runtime limits must be checked in the target tenant.
data.prompt: Help me reuse an existing Office Script for [bounded reporting task] on [workbook/table]. First inspect what already exists and propose the smallest change. Use explicit table names and avoid duplicate objects on rerun. Return manual test cases, expected controls, the correct Excel Online (Business) action for the script's storage location, and failure handling. Do not enable a schedule yet.

replication.useWhen: A stable reporting operation repeats and needs a visible run history.

inputs.name: Existing report table
inputs.detail: Explicit workbook/table name and baseline row count and totals.

inputs.name: Script/flow inventory
inputs.detail: Owner, location, current trigger and output destination.

launch: Open the review workbook and Automate tab; inspect existing scripts before recording a task.
Use a manual flow trigger for the first integration test.

practice.task: Format an existing synthetic report table's header and number columns without adding or deleting rows.
practice.expected: First and second runs have the same rows, values and one table; only the intended formatting changes.

acceptanceTests.expected: No duplicated table, sheet, chart or rows.
A visible failure with context; no success or report replacement.

troubleshooting.symptom: Automate or a connector action is missing
troubleshooting.action: Check existing license and organization policy rather than widening permissions automatically.

troubleshooting.symptom: The flow targets the wrong script location
troubleshooting.action: Choose Run script for OneDrive or Run script from SharePoint library as appropriate.
